name: approvals-banner help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:approvals-banner. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: …and more
entries.text: More calls are waiting than fit here. Tap for the full list.

entries.title: Gets louder over time
entries.text: The alarm starts soft and builds up, so it doesn't make you jump.

entries.title: Seconds to full volume
entries.text: How long the alarm takes to reach full volume.

entries.title: Rings for
entries.text: How long each ring lasts, in seconds.

entries.title: Rings
entries.text: How many times it rings. 1 = once, no repeat.

entries.title: Ring through silent mode
entries.text: On the phone, rings even when it's on silent. For calls you really can't miss.

entries.title: Approvals banner
entries.text: Its settings: notices, the alarm, when it shows.

entries.title: Allow notifications
entries.text: Lets this browser show a notice when a call starts its countdown.

entries.title: Notices (one per held call)
entries.text: Where you set “Notices (one per held call)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Approvals banner.

entries.title: Notice sound
entries.text: Where you set “Notice sound”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Approvals banner.

entries.title: Notice vibration
entries.text: Where you set “Notice vibration”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Approvals banner.

entries.title: Alert again at 30 s left and when it runs
entries.text: Where you set “Alert again at 30 s left and when it runs”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Approvals banner.

entries.title: Overlay
entries.text: The phone overlay's tab: a preview of the floating toolbar in each design option and state, then its settings (side, height, size, when it opens, where pages go).

entries.title: Overlay preview
entries.text: The AmberX overlay toolbar drawn in the current skin inside a phone frame. Pick a design option and a state (collapsed, approval waiting, expanded) to see it; nothing is sent, Deny and Approve here only move the preview.

entries.title: Design option
entries.text: The three toolbar shapes on offer: A pill on the right edge, B slim rail flush with the edge, C round bubble in the corner. The one picked in UI Review is what the phone app builds.

entries.title: Overlay state
entries.text: Collapsed: the always-on toolbar. Approval waiting: the bar it spawns with the countdown, Deny / Approve and a link to the approvals page. Expanded: full screen with the toolbar docked top-left and the browser Amber drives.
